04. Activities & Projects

Minispec Visualizer

Winter 2019 - Summer 2023

Minispec Visualizer is a program that visualizes Hardware Description Language code (Minispec) into a schematic circuit with options to choose multiple depths of circuit visualization, varying from gate level to top-module behavioral level.

Released as a part of Minispec open-source repository and used in 6.004 Computational Structures course's infrastructure to facilitate students in learning about hardware architecture.

redirect( "github.mit.edu/boomzaza/minispec/tree/visualizer" );

Arduino Human Pitch Detection

Spring 2022

Embedded an algorithm to detect human singing pitch onto ESP32 Arduino board using modified SWIPE pitch detection algorithm.

The system uses multiple signal processing techniques such as Short-time Fast Fourier Transform and Cepstral Analysis to accurately estimate the pitch of sounds under moderate levels of noise.

Chladni Wave Resonance Simulator

Fall 2021

Programmed a wave propagation simulation to visualize the Chladni standing wave pattern on any free-form mesh.

The simulation involves multiple numerical analysis techniques such as RK4 Integrator and Laplace-Beltrami operator, and is rendered using custom vertex and fragment shaders from C++ OpenGL API.

Battlecode Competition

Winter 2021

Battlecode is a real-time strategy game in which competitors write an AI player to strategically manage a robot army and cooperate to defeat the enemy team.

The AI player involved a message-efficient distributed communication protocol for different entities on the board to cooperate and strategically outmaneuver opponents.
